title: Firebird SQL Database Server XDR Message Parsing NULL Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Firebird SQL. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of XDR messages. The issue results from dereferencing a null pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
